name: Kvašov (Slovakia)
description: Four horizontal stripes of yellow, red, white and green, the white twice the height of the others, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature K-243/2005.
